summaries.Romania: Romania faces infrastructure challenges with seismic building consolidation lagging severely, while political tensions escalate over constitutional crises and luxury scandals involving PSD leadership. Economic concerns mount as pension indexing and minimum wage debates intensify amid budget pressures.
summaries.Healthcare: The U.S. records its first bird flu death in a year amid cattle exposure concerns, while healthcare AI adoption accelerates with new tools for patient records and clinical decisions, though questions persist about responsibility and equity in AI implementation. Breakthrough treatments emerge for cancer and other conditions as the healthcare system grapples with affordability and workforce challenges.
summaries.Tech: Apple posts record Q4 earnings with $114.5B revenue but faces iPhone Duo supply constraints with no timeline for resolution, while memory chip costs surge and pressure margins heading into the holiday quarter. Anthropic warns of approaching RSI (recursive self-improvement) capabilities, Germany reports potential iPhone spyware targeting lawmakers, and AI regulation debates intensify across the sector.

items.title: Frigiderele din 6 magazine din România, ale aceluiaşi lanţ de supermarketuri, posibil vizate în noul atac care a ridicat temperatura la 50 de grade
items.snippet: Şase magazine din România aparţinând aceluiaşi lanţ comercial au fost vizate de un posibil atac informatic în noaptea de duminică spre luni, după ce echipamentele frigorifice au înregistrat brusc temperaturi neobişnuit de ridicate. Incidentul a fost raportat specialiştilor în securitate informatică,
items.line: Six supermarket chains across Romania were hit by coordinated cyberattacks targeting refrigeration systems, raising alarms about critical infrastructure vulnerability to hacking.

items.title: Washington state resident dies from bird flu following exposure to infected cattle
items.snippet: A person in Washington state has died from complications of the bird flu, the first such U.S. death in a year.
items.line: First U.S. bird flu death in a year following cattle exposure marks escalating risk from zoonotic spillover as virus continues spreading in livestock.

items.title: Apple reports Q4 2026 earnings: $114.5 billion in revenue, up 12% [Charts]
items.snippet:
Apple just released its earnings report for the fourth fiscal quarter of 2026. The company reported $114.5 billion in revenue, and $30.71 billion in net profit. Here’s the full breakdown.



 more…
items.line: Apple reports record $114.5B Q4 revenue driven by iPhone sales, but unprecedented memory chip costs threaten profit margins and suggest coming price increases across the product line.

items.title: Apple says it’s ‘hard to predict’ when iPhone Duo constraints will improve
items.snippet: Apple says iPhone Duo production is ramping up, but it still can't say when supply will catch up with demand as shipping delays stretch into next year.
items.line: iPhone Duo supply constraints have no end date in sight despite strong demand, forcing Apple to admit it cannot predict when production will meet market need.

items.title: Anthropic warns that it’s very close to RSI capability, aka self-building AI
items.snippet: RSI is the point at which AI grows so good at training itself that it spawns a dramatic acceleration of AI capabilities. To the AI doomers, RSI represents the cataclysm from which there is no return.
items.line: Anthropic warns it is 'very close' to RSI (recursive self-improvement) capability where AI can train itself, representing the point at which AI acceleration could become exponential and uncontrollable.

items.title: București, oraș cu bulină roșie. De ce durează atât de mult consolidarea blocurilor cu risc seismic din Capitală. Doi experți explică piedicile
items.snippet: În ultimii 32 de ani, 37 de clădiri cu risc seismic au fost consolidate în București, prin programele derulate de autorități. Orașul are însă peste 2.300 de clădiri cu probleme. Și acestea sunt doar cele care au fost expertizate. Căci cifra reală este mult mai mare. În prezent, un imobil cu probleme
items.line: Only 37 of 2,300+ seismically vulnerable buildings in Bucharest have been consolidated in 32 years, exposing the capital to catastrophic earthquake risk despite decades of failed programs.

items.title: „Ora zero” pentru pensiile din Europa. Țările cu cele mai generoase pensii au rămas fără spațiu de manevră
items.snippet: Timp de decenii, europenii au cedat statului până la jumătate din salariu în schimbul unei promisiuni simple: pensionare la 60 și ceva de ani, cu un venit sigur și decent, garantat pe viață. Promisiunea a supraviețuit crizelor, guvernelor și reformelor amânate, notează Wall Street Journal. Aritmetic
items.line: Europe's generous pension systems face existential pressure as demographic shifts leave countries with shrinking fiscal maneuvering room, forcing difficult reform choices.

items.title: STAT+: FDA OKs generic HIV prevention shot, widening access for lower-income countries
items.snippet: The FDA has approved a generic HIV prevention shot, a key step in widening access for dozens of lower-income countries.
items.line: FDA approval of generic HIV prevention shot expands access for lower-income countries, democratizing preventive medicine across global markets.

items.title: Athenahealth launches tool to bring patient health records into Anthropic's Claude
items.snippet: Athenahealth is opening up patient health records to outside AI assistants, starting with Anthropic’s Claude, through a new MCP connection designed to give patients personalized answers based on their clinical data.
items.line: Athenahealth opens patient health records to Claude AI, marking a watershed moment in integrating large language models directly into clinical workflows with major privacy and liability implications.

items.title: Germany says lawmakers’ iPhones may have been hacked with spyware
items.snippet: German lawmakers and a filmmaker are among the people who received notifications from Apple warning that their phones may have been hacked.
items.line: German authorities investigate spyware attacks on lawmakers' iPhones via Apple notifications, exposing vulnerability of state officials to mercenary hacking despite iOS security reputation.

items.title: In one of the largest deals in tech history, Marvell buys Lumentum for $115B
items.snippet: Marvell's planned purchase of Lumentum is one of the biggest acquisitions in tech history. And they both have the same strategic investor: Nvidia.
items.line: Marvell's $115B acquisition of Lumentum ranks among tech's largest deals ever, consolidating semiconductor supply chains as both companies share Nvidia as strategic investor.

items.line: Apple CEO Ternus faces memory cost headwinds and Siri AI R&D expenses that will compress holiday quarter margins, signaling cost pressures may persist into 2027.

items.title: Coming in 2027: Apple’s $1,000 home robot for FaceTime and switching on lights
items.snippet: Apple robot backed by CEO John Ternus may have hefty price tag and limited uses.
items.line: Apple's $1,000 robotic 'HomeView Ultra' with 9-inch screen headed for 2027/2028 launch signals bold bet on physical AI companions despite limited announced use cases beyond smart home control.

items.title: Comisie parlamentară de anchetă a zborurilor Nordis – Mykonos. PSD a făcut propuneri privind extinderea anchetei
items.snippet: Biroul permanent al Camerei Deputaţilor a decis, luni, înscrierea pe ordinea de zi a plenului a solicitării din partea Grupurilor parlamentare ale USR şi PNL privind constituirea unei Comisii parlamentare de anchetă „Mykonos-Nordis”, pentru verificarea zborurilor private către Mykonos şi Nisa efectu
items.line: Parliamentary investigation into luxury flights by PSD leaders (Mykonos-Nordis scandal) moves forward despite attempts to obstruct, signaling accountability pressure on government elites.

items.title: Kennedy's HHS relaxes enforcement on 6 popular wellness peptides
items.snippet: Stopping short of a formal declaration allowing their use, Department of Health and Human Services Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. has cleared the way for the compounding of six popular wellness peptides.
items.line: HHS Secretary Kennedy clears way for compounding of six wellness peptides, effectively sidestepping formal FDA approval in a significant regulatory shift toward off-label treatments.
